fast.title: Enable fast mode?
fast.what: Fast mode reads the NTFS file table directly instead of opening every folder. Indexing becomes much faster, and changes are picked up through the NTFS change journal.
fast.admin: Windows will ask for administrator permission (a UAC prompt). With fast mode on, it asks each time FindIt starts.
fast.helper: A small helper process gets that permission. It can only read the file table and the change journal. It cannot change, delete or run anything, only your account can talk to it, and it stops when FindIt closes.
fast.visibility: Important: the names of all files on the drive become searchable from your account, including files in folders you cannot normally open, such as other users' folders. File contents are never read.
fast.decline: If you say no to the prompt, FindIt keeps working in standard mode.

general.hotkeyHelp: Click the box and press the keys, for example Ctrl+Alt+Space. Leave it empty for no shortcut.
general.tray: Show the FindIt icon in the notification area
general.closeToTray: Closing the window keeps FindIt running in the notification area
general.startWithWindows: Start FindIt when I sign in to Windows

indexing.drivesHelp: Fixed drives are indexed by default. Removable and network drives are indexed only if you tick them.
indexing.modeStandard: Standard mode: no administrator rights needed
indexing.fastUnsupported: Fast mode needs a local NTFS drive.
indexing.exclusionsHelp: One per line. A name (node_modules) skips that folder everywhere; a full path (C:\Windows\WinSxS) skips that one folder.
indexing.rebuildHelp: Throws the index away and scans everything again.

search.diacritics: Match accents (é is different from e)

about.privacy: FindIt works only on this PC. It has no accounts and sends no data anywhere. The only network request is the update check, and only when you press the button. The index holds file names, paths, sizes, dates and attributes, never file contents.
about.portable: Portable mode: data is stored next to the program.
about.licenses: FindIt is open source under the MIT license. Third-party licenses are listed in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md in the repository.

welcome.title: Welcome to FindIt
welcome.drivesBody: FindIt keeps a list of file names so it can find anything as you type. Nothing leaves this PC.
welcome.fastBody: Standard mode works without administrator rights. Fast mode indexes much faster but asks for administrator permission each time FindIt starts.
welcome.fastNotAvailable: Fast mode needs a local NTFS drive, so FindIt will use standard mode.
welcome.startBody: FindIt will now build its index. You can search right away: results appear while indexing runs. Press Ctrl+Alt+Space at any time to open FindIt.

help.title: Search syntax
help.intro: Type words to find names that contain all of them, in any order. Matching ignores case and accents.
rows: wildcards: * any text, ? one character (whole name)
regular expression (quote it if it contains | or spaces)
match the full path (any term with \ does this too)
size: > < >= <= = or a range; units kb mb gb
image, video, audio, doc, archive, exe, code
per term; on their own (case: Readme) they apply to the whole search
keys: copy the file / copy its path
clear the search; press again to hide FindIt
